04 / AI platforms

MeetOS — An AI platform that turns meetings into real business results

A Windows app and browser extension for Google Meet, Zoom and Teams that transcribes and translates calls, then turns decisions into tasks with owners and deadlines.

Year
2026
Scope
AI platforms
Timeline
3 months

    platforms — Google Meet, Zoom, Teams
  • 5
    meeting modes
  • 2000+
    automated tests

01 / Overview

MeetOS is an AI platform that makes meetings — internal ones and those with clients — produce results. A browser extension and a Windows app capture Google Meet, Zoom and Microsoft Teams calls; the platform transcribes and translates them, summarises the decisions and makes sure the tasks that come out of them get done.

02 / The problem

Companies spend hours in meetings that end without a clear outcome: agreements are forgotten, tasks have no owner or deadline, and a week later nobody checks whether the last meeting's decisions were done.

03 / Our approach

MeetOS covers the whole meeting cycle. Before a call it prepares context on the participants and the topic; during it, the browser extension or the Windows app — which captures the call audio and the microphone — feeds multilingual transcription and a live interpreter mode; afterwards it summarises decisions and agreements, extracts tasks, assigns owners and runs deadlines, reminders and follow-ups in the tools the team already uses.

04 / The result

The platform is complete — Windows app, browser extension, server and admin panel — and passes more than 2,000 automated tests. It runs in two regions, the US and Europe, and is now open to its first pilot partners. Within the ecosystem, MeetOS hands its decisions to RootOS and CompanyOS.

05 / Key features

What it does.

  • 01

    Works with every call

    Google Meet, Zoom and Microsoft Teams through a browser extension on Windows, Mac, Linux and Chromebook; the Windows app captures the call audio and the microphone. A dedicated Mac app is planned.

  • 02

    Multilingual transcription

    Transcribes calls in English, Spanish, French, German, Russian, Arabic and more; Azerbaijani and Turkish are supported in the US region.

  • 03

    Live interpreter mode

    Translates the conversation as it happens, so every participant can follow in their own language.

  • 04

    Summaries and decisions

    Summarises the key discussion, decisions and agreements and keeps a log of them with owners and status.

  • 05

    Tasks into your tools

    Sends tasks and follow-ups to Slack, Teams, Jira, Asana, webhooks and Google or Microsoft calendars; HubSpot and Salesforce switch on with the pilot.

  • 06

    Privacy by default

    Personal data in Azerbaijani — national ID (FİN), IBAN and phone numbers — is masked automatically.

06 / Architecture

How it is built.

  1. Two regions

    Separate US and European regions keep each client's data where it belongs; the platform is ready to deploy on Fly.io.

  2. A regional AI stack

    In the US, Whisper and gpt-oss run on Groq; in Europe, Deepgram Nova-3 transcribes and Azure OpenAI analyses.

  3. Tested end to end

    More than 2,000 automated tests cover the Windows app, the browser extension, the server and the admin panel.
